targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, backend || '/' || COALESCE(model,'?') AS metric, sum(COALESCE(prompt_tokens,0) + COALESCE(completion_tokens,0)) AS value FROM inference_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, backend AS metric, avg(total_ms) AS value FROM inference_latency WHERE total_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN backend ILIKE '%openrouter%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3-235b%' THEN COALESCE(prompt_tokens,0)+COALESCE(completion_tokens,0) ELSE 0 END),0) AS "Billable Tokens", COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN NOT (backend ILIKE '%openrouter%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3-235b%') THEN COALESCE(prompt_tokens,0)+COALESCE(completion_tokens,0) ELSE 0 END),0) AS "Local (Free) Tokens" FROM inference_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT backend AS "Backend", COALESCE(model,'?') AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls", sum(COALESCE(prompt_tokens,0)+COALESCE(completion_tokens,0)) AS "Tokens", round(avg(total_ms)) AS "Avg ms", round(avg(ttft_ms)) AS "Avg TTFT ms", CASE WHEN backend ILIKE '%openrouter%' OR model ILIKE '%qwen3-235b%' THEN 'billable' ELSE 'free' END AS "Cost" FROM inference_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1,2,7 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(backend,'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM web_searches WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS "Total Searches", round(avg(latency_ms)) AS "Avg Latency", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cache_hit) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS "Cache Hit %" FROM web_searches WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT task_id AS "Task", count(*) AS "Runs", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='success') AS "Success", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('failure','timeout')) AS "Fail", round(avg(duration_ms)) AS "Avg ms", to_timestamp(max(started_at)/1000) AS "Last Run" FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint*1000 GROUP BY task_id ORDER BY "Fail" DESC, "Runs" DESC LIMIT 30
